tex_content.html:
\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch6:6-14

Let $(M, g)$ be a connected Riemannian manifold.

  1. Show that $M$ is complete if and only if the compact subsets of $M$ are exactly the closed and bounded ones.

  2. Show that $M$ is compact if and only if it is complete and bounded.

\end{exercise}
